# v2.1.0b5

## 2026-11-08

This beta makes the native C300X display easier to operate while keeping its
original blue design. It includes the previous 2.1.0 beta features and fixes.
The stable release remains **2.0.0**.

## Native Display

- Command feedback appears at the affected entity. Sending, accepted commands,
  matching HA state and failures are distinguished. An uncertain result is not
  automatically retried. HA confirmation is not independent physical verification
  when an entity reports its state optimistically.
- During a connection outage, the last snapshot stays visible and is clearly
  marked as stale. Actions are disabled until the connection recovers.
- Selected-entity updates ignore changes that do not affect the displayed data.
  Unchanged GUI elements are reused, preserving scroll position and subsequent
  slider updates. No additional polling or periodic refresh timers are added.
- Light details provide white/color tabs where supported, keeping brightness
  and power directly accessible. Climate details separate the main temperature
  and HVAC controls from additional settings.
- Tap the overview name/state area or chevron to open details. Separate quick
  actions have larger touch targets and remain direct controls.

## Update

1. In HACS, open the integration menu, choose **Redownload**, enable beta
   versions and select **2.1.0b5**.
2. Restart Home Assistant.
3. Complete the agent-update Repair to install the rebuilt **2.1.0b5** agent.
4. Reapply the **Display patch**, including when upgrading from an earlier beta.
   Applying it restarts the device GUI.

Local Qt rendering and interaction tests do not replace testing on the actual
C300X. Physical display behavior and Ring Call interruption remain beta checks.

See [beta and update guidance](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v2.1.0b5/docs/advanced-maintenance.md#beta-versions)
and [display controls](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v2.1.0b5/docs/feature-reference.md#display-device-controls).
